_comment: Real work, not stock. Two Austin short-term rentals shot by THE LOST+UNFOUNDS: the Pease Park unit (2026-08-02) and 501 W 30th St #2 (2026-08-11). Images are NOT bundled — they are served from the platform's own gallery endpoint, which already holds them, returns any requested width, and ships a one-year immutable cache. `alt` is required on every entry and the build fails without it: the site publishes a WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility statement, and an unlabelled photograph on a photography site is the one image a screen reader most needs described.

bedroom-hero.alt: Bedroom in an Austin short-term rental: a four-poster bed made up in white linen with a folded orange throw across the foot, beneath a framed black and white print.

bedroom-wide.alt: Wider view of the same Austin rental bedroom, showing the four-poster frame, ceiling fan, window blinds and folded towels laid out on the bed.

living-arcade.alt: Living room of an Austin short-term rental with a patterned mural wall, a stand-up arcade cabinet, wall-mounted television and a sectional sofa.

kitchen.alt: Kitchen of an Austin short-term rental with stainless steel appliances, a gas range, trailing plants above the cabinets and a wooden dining table.

dining.alt: Dining area and galley kitchen in an Austin short-term rental, with a small table, framed abstract art and a potted plant on the counter.

bathroom.alt: Bathroom in an Austin short-term rental, showing the vanity, mirror, overhead lighting and wall cabinet.

entry-door.alt: Covered entry walkway of an Austin short-term rental leading to a bright blue front door, with trees visible beyond the railing.
